en-US.title: Senzilytics
en-US.subtitle: EHS Intelligence in the Field
en-US.description:
Senzilytics gives authorized Premium tenant users secure native access to environmental, health, safety, ESG, risk, audit-service, research, compliance, employee-performance, and executive workflows. Review assigned tasks, execute corrective actions, capture observations and incidents, complete inspections and Audits, collect governed research responses, review operational intelligence, work through unreliable connectivity, and synchronize protected records with your organization's Senzilytics workspace.

A provisioned Senzilytics Premium tenant account is required. Organization access, roles, permissions, module assignments, subscription entitlements, account status, and session revocation are enforced by the Senzilytics platform.
en-US.promoText: Native, offline-ready operational intelligence for authorized Senzilytics teams.
